_about: Which file each feed reads and how to parse it. Each feed states its settings in full - there is no shared defaults block, so a feed can be read and changed without consulting anything else in this file. The connection is still referenced by name from connection_config.json. Every feed key here must also exist in destination_config.json.
_shape_note: Per feed: connection, source_type, file (identity and/or match), format, header, validation, file_overrides, columns, primary_key. Anything genuinely omitted still falls back to runtime_config.json, but feeds are written out in full so nothing is implicit.

dataset1.description: Dataset1.csv in a shared folder, resolved by exact name.

file_daily.description: Date-stamped daily drop, e.g. file20260926.csv, selected by glob.

format._quote_note: This source quotes only its non-numeric field (DDD arrives as 'A'), as a QUOTE_NONNUMERIC-style export does. A double quote here would keep the apostrophes and store DDD as the literal 'A'.

file_daily._pk_note: AAA is unique within one drop but repeats across drops, and all drops land in one table. The uniqueness check therefore validates each drop in isolation, not the table as a whole.
